build_tokenizer_pipeline: build a data pipeline that tokenizes text strings into token ids using the Tokenize transform
create_seq2seq_fields: create input target and loss mask fields from prompt and response token sequences using AddSeq2SeqFields
pad_token_sequences: pad token sequences to a fixed max length with zeros using the Pad transform
format_text_with_template: format text strings using a template with the FormatText transform containing a text placeholder
decode_bytes_to_string: decode byte sequences to utf-8 strings using the DecodeBytes element-wise transform
